subtitle: Tracker · Model:02 · firmware 6.6.3
description: One song, Low Tide, built step by step on the M8; two techniques, Tables and Sampling; and ten instrument patch cards to look up.
note: A book to read with the M8 in your hands. Do Low Tide's steps in order; the patch cards at the back are for looking up. The pictures are the M8's own screens. Flats in the text are spelled with a plain b (Bbmaj9, A7b9); the pictures show the real sign. The live version, with sound, is the Methodos app.
